title: 저는 지금과 같은 시장에 매우 만족함
methodology_takeaway: Persistent rate-valuation fear and uncertainty can coexist with strong returns; increasing capitulation by pessimists is a warning sign.

title: 화이또님 말이 맞음여
methodology_takeaway: Explicitly describes the current phase as late optimism and argues late-optimism returns can be unusually important.

title: 약세장 이후의 이야기
methodology_takeaway: Do not classify leaders only by total drawdown. Track who held up in the first half of the bear and who capitulated later; post-bottom leadership often follows this sequence.

title: 저는타워타워라고봄
methodology_takeaway: A prior bull-market leader can re-emerge around the next bull's middle phase; prior-cycle leadership is useful context, not a deterministic rule.

title: 올해 테크에 관해서
methodology_takeaway: 2022-23 Tech leadership is interpreted partly through bounce effect. Early-bull leaders reflect sentiment rebound relative to supply growth; global and non-US sector context matters.

title: 저는 미국 ALT비즈니스 생각중임여
methodology_takeaway: A wall of worry can support rebounds; issuance and roll-up intensity should be judged relative to market size rather than in isolation.

title: 스타일 리더십4
methodology_takeaway: Part of the author's style-leadership series; maintain style leadership as a separate layer from sector leadership.

title: 사이클3
methodology_takeaway: Small-value leadership can persist for multi-year stretches after major bear markets; short windows need cycle context.

title: 켄 피셔 반등효과에 대해서 (23년 칼럼)
methodology_takeaway: Prior bear-market damage is a key explanatory variable for early-bull leadership.

title: 켄 피셔 리딩섹터란
methodology_takeaway: Prices respond to reality versus expectations. Early bull: expectation reversal; middle: consistency/compounding; late: expectations and perceived safety become elevated.

title: 제가 saas 버블 주장한게 22년도거든요
methodology_takeaway: IPO and equity issuance are supply, not automatically bullish. Sustainable leadership requires demand/sentiment improvement to outrun new security/business supply.

title: 켄피셔 2025년 투자자 질문 답변
methodology_takeaway: Bull market: pessimism -> skepticism -> optimism -> euphoria; stage duration is not fixed.

title: 켄 피셔 투자자 감정
methodology_takeaway: Not-euphoria judgment relied partly on expert expectations being too pessimistic and economic data surprising positively; consensus forecast error matters.

title: 켄 피셔 2003년 인터뷰
methodology_takeaway: Long-run category return differences can be dominated by brief post-bear rebounds; focus on which category leads now rather than assuming permanent factor premia.

title: 기회비용 손실
methodology_takeaway: Separates bull-market stages from bear-market stages; large portions of returns can occur near pessimism/euphoria transitions.

title: 주식시장의 선행지표 (켄피셔)
methodology_takeaway: LEI components, yield curve and credit/lending context are regime context, not direct style-leadership signals.

title: IPO와 유상증자
methodology_takeaway: IPO/SPAC/equity issuance are central euphoria/supply indicators; low issuance can coexist with optimism, while issuance excess is late-cycle warning evidence.
